title: The Soft Gyre
summary: A house-sized translucent gel blob hovers above anvil thunderheads, spins, and throws sparks and jello at the weather. Clouds dent, lantern, and grow glass flowers. The gyre spins clockwise; every ejecta counter-rotates. Five locked stills, ready to animate.
visualArc: Hover above the deck → jello weather + dented cloud → interior helix and cloud-bubbles → vapor tendril answers → pull-back, halo, glass flower, undersun flare.
